method: Independent Manifold64 finite ray casts on exported part meshes; 36 radial directions per station and 73 ideal optical rays

source_seam_contact_diagnostic.interpretation: Contact-merged chords treat micron source seams as backing material. They do not alter the delivered mesh or replace the strict measurements.

optics_assumptions.scope: Only body and bezel occlusion, for the assumed nominal lens tip. Not an actual optical certificate.
